description: This file defines the interface for integrating the libev event loop with hiredis asynchronous Redis client, including event handling, addition, removal, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: redisLibevReadEvent
methods.description: Handles read events for the libev event loop, calling redisAsyncHandleRead.

methods.name: redisLibevWriteEvent
methods.description: Handles write events for the libev event loop, calling redisAsyncHandleWrite.

methods.name: redisLibevAddRead
methods.description: Enables reading events on the libev event loop.

methods.name: redisLibevDelRead
methods.description: Disables reading events on the libev event loop.

methods.name: redisLibevAddWrite
methods.description: Enables writing events on the libev event loop.

methods.name: redisLibevDelWrite
methods.description: Disables writing events on the libev event loop.

methods.name: redisLibevCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the libev event structure.

methods.name: redisLibevAttach
methods.description: Attaches the Redis async context to the libev event loop, initializing event watchers.
